goals.title: T0 decompose seam
goals.objective: Extract a standalone decompose(raw_text)->competency_tree function in backend/services/course_engine.py, decoupled from the full generation pipeline. Refactor-first; existing backend/tests/test_course_engine.py must stay green.

goals.title: T2 eval harness
goals.objective: Build a decomposition eval harness: a rubric scorer (no cycles, genuine prerequisites, cold-start roots, correct ordering) run over 5 varied sources (>=3 domains, >=3 source types, one messy). Human-graded ground truth is authoritative; record scores. This must exist before T3.

goals.title: T2.5 demoable CLI
goals.objective: Add a CLI entrypoint: ingest a source, run decompose() + the eval scorer, print the competency tree and its rubric score. Forcing function so moat work has a visible result.

goals.title: T1 empty-guard
goals.objective: In decompose(), reject empty/malformed/refusal LLM output with a named error, retry once with a stricter prompt, and NEVER persist an empty or partial tree. User sees 'couldn't structure this source'. Add tests for image-only PDF, malformed JSON, refusal.

goals.title: T4 multi-source ingest
goals.objective: Create backend/services/ingest/ with per-source parsers (PDF moved from upload.py, plus YouTube transcript, URL, pasted text, .md) sharing a normalize()->raw_text contract. Reject empty/garbage at upload with named errors. Wire into backend/routers/upload.py. Add a fixture test per source type.

goals.title: T3 judge (conditional)
goals.objective: LLM-judge self-repair of the competency tree, async/skippable, that KEEPS the repaired tree only if it scores >= the original on the eval rubric, else reverts. BUILD ONLY IF T2 shows decomposition is good-but-improvable AND a quick prototype shows the judge raises the eval score. Otherwise skip and record why.

goals.title: T5+T6 robustness
goals.objective: Add huge-source cap/chunking so a 500-page source does not hang or exceed the token limit, and structured logging of source hash, raw LLM output, parsed tree, and eval score for every decomposition.

goals.title: T8+T7 identity+correction
goals.objective: Add stable UUID competency node ids in md_store (renames must not reset mastery). Add human-in-loop correction minimum slice: edit/persist a decomposition with prerequisite-cycle rejection; defer mastery-state reconciliation.

goals.title: T9+T10+T11 hardening
goals.objective: SSRF + prompt-injection guard on URL/YouTube ingestion; per-call Ollama timeout so a hung judge cannot stall ingestion; external ground-truth spot-check on >=1 unfamiliar-domain source before trusting the harness.

claudeObjective: Complete all ultragoal stories in .omc/ultragoal/goals.json: G001-t0-decompose-seam T0 decompose seam; G002-t2-eval-harness T2 eval harness; G003-t2-5-demoable-cli T2.5 demoable CLI; G004-t1-empty-guard T1 empty-guard; G005-t4-multi-source-ingest T4 multi-source ingest; G006-t3-judge-conditional T3 judge (conditional); G007-t5-t6-robustness T5+T6 robustness; G008-t8-t7-identity-correction T8+T7 identity+correction; G009-t9-t10-t11-hardening T9+T10+T11 hardening
